notes: No brand slot: the host mark is the AppFrame profile Avatar. The opaque fallback is automatic: surface=glass paints an opaque raised surface when backdrop blur is unsupported or reduced transparency or forced colors is active; it is not separately selectable.
Descriptor only; anatomy, source, accessibility, contrast, layout and rendered conformance are unmeasured.

Canonical Designer Frames owns AppFrame. layout=immersive floats a glass header over the stage and opens with the navigation collapsed; stage=full drops the main inset. The header slot is the app-header context region; the page header itself is leased through PageHeaderModule, never a frame prop. The width port is the resizable inspector (rightPanel) width in pixels; the sidebar width is fixed. The theme port is a controlled preference passed through to ThemeProvider; without it the provider owns and stores the preference. Command state is internally owned; no progress slot is exposed.

account and theme can be composed by the host in footer; they are not dedicated slots. Theme state is owned by the app shell (AppFrame theme port), so the sidebar contract has no theme state port. Tree uses disclosure navigation; no navigation-tree conformance is claimed.
